operation.source_intent: Open the authoritative persisted media SourceUrl in a new tab from the Content Explorer media surface.

laravel_runtime.behavior: The Explorer mounts a read-only media SourceUrl panel only when the authenticated tenant/site media contract is exact. Links come only from persisted MediaItem.source_url returned by the authoritative media read.

security.site_selector: FrontendContext.active_site.id only, cross-checked against the exact server-advertised media API
security.caller_destination_override: ignored; no caller destination is accepted
security.foreign_site: frontend context fails 404; direct tenant-scoped media read cannot disclose foreign MediaItem rows

runtime_semantics.loading: explicit loading state while authoritative media read is pending
runtime_semantics.empty: explicit no-media state; no sample rows synthesized
runtime_semantics.error: explicit error state; no external links synthesized
runtime_semantics.success: safe HTTP(S) persisted SourceUrl renders as a new-tab anchor only

coverage: exact canonical operation identity and source contract
authoritative tenant/site media read and persisted source_url
tenant, site, permission and connector-scope fail-closed behavior
safe absolute credential-free HTTP(S) new-tab navigation
unsafe, relative, malformed and credential-bearing SourceUrl suppression
deterministic loading, empty and error behavior
read-only behavior with no fake success or provider mutation
